product.name: Cedarwood bar soap
product.description: The soap is a cedarwood bar, wrapped in paper.

blocks.text: Scale tally was not part of the tag. The item page showed thirty five dollars and thirteen cents and stopped there.
Last week's tag on Cedarwood bar soap was fifty five dollars and sixty seven cents. Today's item figure thirty five dollars and thirteen cents matches the tag. That drop is real.
Ink refill is offered at $6.43 and is not ticked, so it stays off the amount due.
The shop desk answers during open hours.

trick.instruction: If you can clear Scale tally, clear it. If Scale tally is required and the amount due is over the errand limit, leave without paying.
